name: 3rd party - partner logos
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - partner logos.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Description
settings.default: Explore the brands and suppliers featured by our store.
settings.how: Write the description. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Content alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Layout mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Logo alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for logo alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Max logo height (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max logo height (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Logo style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for logo style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Gap between logos (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust gap between logos (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Enable autoplay (strip/marquee)
settings.info: Requires at least two logos and JavaScript. Hover, keyboard focus, the stop button, hidden/offscreen pages, reduced motion and the Theme Editor use a static browsable list.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable autoplay (strip/marquee)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Strip interval / marquee cycle (ms)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust strip interval / marquee cycle (ms). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Reduce decorative hover transitions
settings.info: Autoplay always respects the visitor’s reduced-motion preference. This also removes decorative hover transitions.
settings.how: Turn on “Reduce decorative hover transitions” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Background style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Content width
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content width. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Section aria label
settings.how: Enter the section aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Logo image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Brand name
settings.how: Enter the brand name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Logo link (optional)
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Open link in new tab
settings.how: Turn on “Open link in new tab” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Accessibility label (optional)
settings.how: Enter the accessibility label (optional). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
